response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_price FROM Products), kept_types AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average FROM type_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.type_average > o.overall_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS mean_type_average FROM kept_types) SELECT AVG(k.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_average - o.overall_price) AS average_above_overall, AVG(k.type_average - m.mean_type_average) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM kept_types AS k CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.type_average > m.mean_type_average
